import json
n_code, n_total, n_filt = 0, 0, 0
int_ok, det_ok = 0, 0
labels = {'det-preferred':0, 'internal-preferred':0, 'no-preference':0}
raw_labels = {'det-preferred':0, 'internal-preferred':0, 'no-preference':0}
with open('/root/autodl-tmp/simgate-modular-routing/data/math-counterfactual/pilot_50.jsonl') as f:
    for line in f:
        d = json.loads(line)
        n_total += 1
        if d['deterministic']['n_rounds'] > 0: n_code += 1
        if d.get('filtered'): n_filt += 1
        if d['internal']['correct']: int_ok += 1
        if d['deterministic']['correct']: det_ok += 1
        labels[d['label']] += 1
        raw_labels[d.get('raw_label', d['label'])] += 1
n = n_total
print(f'=== Interim @ {n} problems ===')
print(f'Code exec rate: {n_code}/{n} ({100*n_code/n:.0f}%)')
print(f'Internal acc: {int_ok}/{n} ({100*int_ok/n:.0f}%)')
print(f'CodeInterp acc: {det_ok}/{n} ({100*det_ok/n:.0f}%)')
print(f'Filtered: {n_filt}/{n}')
print(f'Labels (raw): det={raw_labels[\"det-preferred\"]}, int={raw_labels[\"internal-preferred\"]}, nopref={raw_labels[\"no-preference\"]}')
print(f'Labels (filtered): det={labels[\"det-preferred\"]}, int={labels[\"internal-preferred\"]}, nopref={labels[\"no-preference\"]}')
"
